description: Use this when the signed-in clipper asks to save a campaign, or to unsave it with saved false. A saved campaign gets alerts for its next rounds, rate rises, top-ups and budget run-out. Takes the campaign as brand/series or its page URL. Needs the clipper's ClippingAlpha sign-in. Changes only their own saves.

campaign.description: brand/series, for example lovable/clipping, or its page URL.

saved.description: true to save (the default), false to remove.

name: save_campaign
title: Save a campaign
